newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Coke Enterprises raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coke Enterprises raised.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it upgraded Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc to strong buy from buy.
-- said raised the 12-month price target to $26 a share from $23 a share.
-- cited Tuesday's announcement that Coca-Cola Enterprises plans to buy two major North American Coke bottlers for about $1.66 billion.
-- said although the deal will dilute earnings per share by about $0.05 a share in both 1997 and 1998, the acquisitions will ultimately accelerate the company's EBITDA growth rate.
-- said it is also bullish about the company's opportunities in France.
